name: tron-p256-passkey-app
description: Monorepo: Next.js + Expo example apps demonstrating TRON P256VERIFY utilizing expo-passkey, end-to-end.

scripts.build:wallet-core:cjs: tsc packages/wallet-core/src/index.ts --outDir packages/wallet-core/.cjs-build --module commonjs --target es2022 --moduleResolution node --skipLibCheck
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build:wallet-core:cjs && cd tron_contracts && tronbox test --network development

//overrides: better-auth 1.7.x ships a @better-fetch/fetch whose generics are incompatible with expo-passkey@0.3.15's client plugin types (getActions is not assignable to BetterAuthClientPlugin). Held at the last known-good set until expo-passkey supports better-fetch >=1.3.
